title: GRADE 3
text:
ENGLISH GRADE 3 2024
 LEARNER’S COPY
Komu’s mother sent him to the market to buy tomatoes and oranges. She
gave Komu some money and told him, “Keep the money safely.”
On the way to the market, Komu met an old man. The old man was
standing by the road. He said to Komu, “My son, please help me to cross
the road.”
Komu remembered that their teacher had taught them how to cross the
road.
Komu held the old man’s hand and they both crossed the road safely.
“Thank you,” said the old man.
“Welcome,” Komu said.
Komu then went to the market. He bought tomatoes and oranges. He
then ran back home. Komu was surprised to find the old man seated in
their house.

 SECTION A
 Grade 3 2024
 TEACHER’S COPY
 Task 1 and Task 2
Time: 15 Minutes Per Learner
Instructions to the teacher
1. The teacher informs all learners that the task will be a face-to-face assessment,
 therefore, learners will be called into the assessment room when their turn comes
 (one after the other).
2. Task 1 (Listening and Speaking) comprises Part 1 and Part 2.
3. The learner should be given a seat facing the teacher.
4. At the beginning of Task 1, the teacher explains the expectations of the task.
5. The teacher asks the questions provided in Task 1 Part 1
6. The teacher indicates the end of Task 1 Part 1 and introduces Task 1 Part 2.
7. The teacher assesses and records the competency of each learner based on the provided
 assessment rubric.
8. The teacher must have an assessment sheet for Task 1 for each learner.
© The Kenya National Examinations Council
TASK 1: LISTENING AND SPEAKING
Part 1
The teacher greets the learner. The learner responds. The teacher asks the learner to
sit.
The teacher tells the learner:
“I will tell you something and then ask you some questions about it.” (Teacher
repeats)
It is good to keep our environment clean. (Teacher repeats)
 1. Tell me, how do you keep your classroom clean? (Learner responds)
 2. What will happen if your classroom is dirty? (Learner responds)
 3. What will your teacher say if your classroom is dirty? (Learner responds)
Part 2
The teacher tells the learner:
“Listen carefully to the passage that I am going to read, and then you will answer
in English the questions I am going to ask you.”
On Friday, Grade 3 pupils went to the park to see wild animals. They saw
elephants and zebras. (Teacher repeats)
 4. When did Grade 3 pupils go to the park? (Learner responds)
 5. Which animals did they see? (Learner responds)
© The Kenya National Examinations Council
TASK 2: READING ALOUD
Instructions to the teacher
1. The teacher explains to the learner the expectations of Task 2.
2. The learner should be provided with a copy of the passage.
3. As the learner reads aloud, the teacher listens to the learner and times him/her for one
 minute.
4. The teacher indicates with a stroke (/) the point where the learner reaches in the passage
 at the end of one minute.
5. The teacher allows the learner to continue reading to the end of the passage.
6. The teacher underlines all the words the learner could not read correctly or had difficulty
 pronouncing.
7. The teacher indicates on the scoring guide the number of words the learner read correctly
 (total number of words read within one minute minus the words read with errors).
8. The teacher assesses and records the competency of the learner based on the assessment
 rubric provided.
9. The teacher must have an assessment sheet for each learner for Task 2.
The teacher says, as he/she points at the passage: “I would like you to read this
story aloud”.

SECTION B
TASK 3: READING COMPREHENSION
Read the story below and then answer the questions that follow.
My best friend
My best friend is Rajesh. He sits next to me in class. We read and play together.
One day, it rained heavily. As we walked home, Rajesh told me not to walk in a pool
of water. He said, “Ochola, if you walk in water, you can hit a stone and hurt your
toe. This can be very painful.” Rajesh also told me that sometimes there could be a
dangerous hole in a pool of water.
 1. How do we know that Rajesh and Ochola are in the same class?
 2. The word “dangerous” means _____. useless new harmful
 3. What shows that Rajesh is a good friend? (Choose one correct answer)
 A. He always plays with everyone.
 B. He likes reading books in class.
 C. He does not want Ochola to get hurt.
 4. What will happen if Ochola does not listen to Rajesh?
© The Kenya National Examinations Council
Read the story below and then answer the questions that follow.
Bongo and the Frog
One day, Bongo went to the river to catch some fish. He waited for a long time
before catching any fish. At last, he caught something. It was a big frog! Bongo
walked home. He was unhappy.
“Bongo, where is the fish?” his father asked.
“There is no fish. I only caught a frog.”
Bongo’s father told him, “Some careless people must have thrown dangerous things
into the river. This may have killed a lot of fish.”
 5. What did Bongo catch?
 6. Why was Bongo unhappy?
 7. There was no fish in the river. Why?
 8. What will happen if all the fish in the river die?
© The Kenya National Examinations Council
Read the story below and then answer the questions that follow.
Sara and the Puppy
Sara was not happy. Her new pet was missing. Nobody knew where the puppy had
gone to.
 9. Sara was not happy. She was ______. glad hungry sad
 10. Sara’s pet is the young one of a __________.
Read the story below and then answer the questions that follow.
Juma and Chewa
Juma took his school uniform to Chewa. Chewa is a tailor. Chewa told Juma to go back
for his uniform later. Juma went back after an hour. He found the uniform ready.
The uniform was inside a bag. Juma picked the bag and ran home. He opened the bag.
It was not his uniform.
 11. Why did Juma take his uniform to Chewa?
 12. Why did Chewa tell Juma to go back for his uniform later? (Choose one
 correct answer)
 A. He was not at the shop.
 B. He did not have a bag.
 C. He was very busy.
 13. What did Juma do when he found that his uniform was not in the bag?
© The Kenya National Examinations Council
Read the poem below and then answer the questions that follow.
Rain
Rain on the green grass,
And rain on the trees,
And rain on the housetop,
But not rain on us.
 14. Grass and trees need ________.
 15. Another word for housetop is r _ _ f .
 16. What will happen if rain falls on us?
